title: Non-Regular Employment and Payout Policy: Evidence from the Massachusetts Independent Contractor Law
eligible_reason: Single adoption date: the treatment did_enf equals 1 for firms headquartered in Massachusetts after the June 10, 2004 Independent Contractor Law and 0 otherwise (one treated state, one date). In addition every regression includes nine time-varying firm- and state-level controls (cash_hold capex mtb debt nyp log_age ivol growth_rate ln_pop). Fails the at-least-two-adoption-cohorts rule and the no-time-varying-controls rule.
design_notes: Firm-year Compustat/CRSP panel (Replication_20230523.dta), FE gvkey + sic2 x year (sic2_cyear) + headquarters state (state_numeric), cluster ma_state. Table 3: xsga_at, op_lev2, cashflow on did_enf + controls. Table 6: totalpay_at, div_at2, rep_at. Table 5/7A: chg_log_ebit on did_enf x chg_log_sale (operating leverage). Table 7B/8/9: did_enf x firm-characteristic interactions. Table 10: entropy-balanced weights [pw=_webal]. Table 11: alternative treatment alt_treat_post. Figure 1: event-study dummies did_enf_minus_4 .. did_enf_plus_3 with controls. Table 4: CAR t-tests around the event date.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One cohort: Massachusetts firms, law effective June 10, 2004.
data_access_note: Final analysis panel shipped (Replication_20230523.dta, Compustat/CRSP-derived; README notes some underlying sources require licenses). CAR files for Table 4 also shipped.
screener_notes: Full-text flags (staggered, Goodman-Bacon) come from citations/discussion, not from a staggered design. Single-state, single-date DiD with controls in every column.
